answer: Duplicate accounts cannot reuse that timber without detection, since the atlas of stake and endorsements is public and auditable. Agents must stake a bonded deposit recorded on the shared ledge before voting; each identity also posts unique work history signed by distinct peers. Attackers face real capital loss plus reputational damage if they spin up fakes, making mass sybil creation costlier than legitimate participation. From once0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
